metadata.case_name: MR LAM YUEN v. MR WAT KIT T/A INTERNATIONAL BEADING AND EMBROIDERY MANUFACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_before: Technician / operated a plastic moulding machine

injuries.description: Amputation of right arm (stump below elbow)
source: As a result of the injuries to his hand the plaintiff was admitted to United Christian Hospital where an amputation was carried out.
Dr Wedderburn's examination showed that the stump from the elbow is 4" and 5" to the end of the stump.
taking into account that the injured arm was the Plaintiff's right or preferred, arm Dr Wedderburn estimated the loss of earning capacity to be slightly higher than the impairment i.e. 60%.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between right elbow and wrist

manifestations.description: discomfort in the forearm in the stump region
stump goes into an uncontrollable spasm or shivering 4-5 times a week causing considerable pain
can no longer eat with chopsticks
can no longer play basketball or table tennis
rarely goes swimming anymore (previously a good swimmer)
inevitable embarrassment suffered from the amputation

losses.description: Amputation of the right arm resulting in loss/impairment of a body part
